subject: Sienna Works: treasury beneficiary switch & PO approver update
messages:

To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: treasury@siennaworks.com
Date: 2027-09-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request to change beneficiary account + new PO approver

Hi Chloe,

Hope you’re well. We completed onboarding last quarter and have a small change on our end that needs to be reflected in your vendor master. Our treasury team consolidated receivables to a new beneficiary account (same bank, different beneficiary name & account). We also have a new purchasing contact who should be the PO approver for all future orders: Marco Diaz (marco.diaz@siennaworks.com).

Attached are: the signed ACH authorization (sienna_ach_form.pdf) and an updated W-9 (sienna_w9_updated.pdf). Can you confirm the procedure you need from Procurement/AP to update these fields in your system? We have an open vendor-portal ticket (VA-9123) but wanted to loop you in directly because we have a shipment scheduled the week of 9/20 and want invoices routed to the new beneficiary.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance | Sienna Works LLC
phone: +1 415-555-0192

[attachment: sienna_ach_form.pdf] [attachment: sienna_w9_updated.pdf]

From: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@siennaworks.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to change beneficiary account + new PO approver

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the forms. I received the ACH form and updated W-9. A couple quick notes on process so we’re aligned:

- Procurement needs the ACH + W-9 on file; AP requires the vendor record change and a confirmation from Procurement before remittances switch.
- For PO routing/approver changes, we update the "primary PO contact" field in the vendor profile and then our purchasing workflow will start sending approvals to Marco.
- Because you have a shipment next week, please confirm whether you need us to reissue any outstanding POs to the new PO contact now or after the vendor record is updated. Reissuing is straightforward but requires a short re-approval.

I’ll kick this over to Procurement (cc’d Laura) to make the vendor record change. Laura/Sean, can you: 1) upload the new ACH & W-9 to the vendor master, 2) change the beneficiary name/account per the ACH, and 3) set Marco Diaz as primary PO approver? Please flag if you need any additional signed confirmation.

Elena: I can confirm by EOD once Procurement updates the record.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
mobile: (650) 555-1881

[inline: quoted attachments: sienna_ach_form.pdf, sienna_w9_updated.pdf]

Hi Chloe,

Thanks 9-- yes please proceed with the vendor record update now.

On reissuing POs: please reassign any pending POs to Marco and we will route re-approval through him. If possible, please expedite for PO #12874 (expected shipment 9/21). I included Marco so he can acknowledge the change.

Let me know if you need a board-signed letter of authorization for the beneficiary change; treasury confirmed an internal memo is available and we can upload if needed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Elena

Please confirm once steps are completed, copying Elena for confirmation. If any of this requires finance sign-off, loop in Sean.

Thanks,
Chloe
